description: Say what you need in plain words (any language), e.g. "check IBAN BE68539007547034" or "can BE0403170701 receive Peppol invoices?". Jithox picks the right tool from all its products (payments, e-invoicing, VAT and companies, EU energy labels, import, sanctions), calls it and returns its answer. If the task lacks a value, nothing runs: you get the tool and its schema; call again with `tool` and `arguments`.

arguments.description: Optional: the tool's arguments; used as given instead of reading them from the task.

dry_run.description: Optional: true picks the tool and fills the arguments but runs nothing.

task.description: What you want done, with the values it is about.

tool.description: Optional: the tool to use (from an earlier answer); skips the pick.

name: jithox_task
title: Do a Jithox task
